title: Herb Infused Vietnamese Pork Nem Nuong
description: Savory and light, this Vietnamese dish features red onions and render fat, making it a great low sodium option. It is a show off dish that is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, grated ginger, garlic, and black pepper.
Mix everything together until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Add the sliced red onion to the bowl and mix until the onion is evenly distributed.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small cylinders, about 1 inch in diameter and 2 inches long.
Place the nem nuong on the grill and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
While the nem nuong is cooking, prepare the render fat by heating it in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the nem nuong is cooked, brush it with the render fat and serve immediately.
Serve the nem nuong with your favorite dipping sauce and enjoy.
